port: mount(el, shot) builds the two blocks, splits '.cap p' into .w spans and adds header/line/footer; animate(el, shot, D) returns the timeline with enter at 0.025D and 0.225D, hold 0.42-0.75D, exits at 0.75D/0.81D.
